rule: Linked: within 0.01 deg, one registry id, one UHSLC number within 0.1 deg, or equal names with agreeing tides and one site code or 1 km within 0.05 deg. Joined along a link when names agree and M2/K1 agree (12 %/25 %, 7.5 % beyond 1 km without a UHSLC link; K1 only for 6-month records; 10 deg); a clock offset joins only at one position or on a registry/UHSLC link within 1 km; no fit: position, name and country. Cut groups: proposals; cut same-name records: flagged. Id: OTC- + sha256(founder)[:8] (+2 hex while taken). Ids never removed or reused; a record keeps its station; joining or dividing existing stations needs a decision. See otc_pipeline/station_map.py.
